node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-1538 exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 1538 is impossible. Its valuation mu=1 and residual V in {4,6,8,10,12} would require autocorrelation energy 2 through 6. A complete 1969-affine-orbit classification with two exact XOR engines proves that no such coefficient vector exists.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual pair-plus-third and triple-table engines agree on 2216832 low-energy targets, 16970 candidate heavy supports, and 135760 exact sign tests. Eleven profile-(3,6) cofactors remain.
